Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What tests are included in the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Basic package?
The Thyrocare Anemia Profile Basic package includes approximate 69 tests. These cover iron deficiency tests (iron, TIBC, UIBC, transferrin saturation, ferritin), complete blood count (CBC), thyroid profile (T3, T4, TSH), lipid profile, liver and kidney function tests, blood sugar markers, and important vitamins such as B12 and folate.
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Basic package?
This health package is ideal for individuals experiencing symptoms of anemia such as fatigue, dizziness, pale skin, or weakness. It is also suitable for those with a history of nutritional deficiencies or anyone seeking a broad screening of blood health, iron status, and vitamin levels.
3. Is fasting required before giving the sample for this Thyrocare package?
Yes, fasting for 10 to 12 hours is recommended before providing your sample. During this time, only water is allowed. Fasting ensures accurate results, especially for sugar, lipid, and liver-related tests.
4. How is the sample collected for Thyrocare’s Anemia Profile Basic package?
Thyrocare offers convenient home sample collection. A trained technician will visit your home at your selected date and time to collect blood samples safely and hygienically.
5. What is the price of the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Basic package?
The package is priced at 2,600 Rs. It includes free home sample collection and a wide range of tests, offering excellent value for money.
6. When will I receive the Thyrocare test reports?
Digital test reports are generally delivered within 24 to 48 hours after the sample is collected. Thyrocare ensures secure and timely delivery through email or mobile access.
7. Is the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Basic package available across India?
Yes, this package is available throughout India. Thyrocare provides home collection services in most cities and towns, making health testing accessible and convenient.
8. What makes the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Basic package unique?
This package goes beyond routine health checkups by focusing on key anemia-related parameters. It offers a comprehensive view of your blood health, nutritional status, and underlying causes of fatigue, with all tests conducted in Thyrocare’s fully automated, NABL-accredited laboratories for high accuracy and reliability.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the Anemia Profile Advanced test by Thyrocare?
The Anemia Profile Advanced by Thyrocare is a comprehensive diagnostic test package that evaluates essential parameters like iron levels, vitamin B12, and folate to detect anemia and its underlying causes.
Who should take the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test?
This test is ideal for individuals experiencing symptoms such as fatigue, weakness, dizziness, pale skin, or those with a history of nutritional deficiencies or chronic conditions.
What tests are included in the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced package?
The Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), Iron Studies, Ferritin, Vitamin B12, Folate, and other vital tests to diagnose anemia accurately.
How is the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test beneficial?
The test helps in early detection of anemia, identifies the specific type (like iron deficiency or megaloblastic anemia), and provides insights for effective treatment through nutrient monitoring.
Do I need to fast before taking the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test?
Yes, fasting for 8-10 hours is recommended before the test to ensure accurate results. You may drink water during the fasting period.
How can I book the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test online?
Booking the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test is easy through our website. Simply schedule the test, and our home collection service will ensure hassle-free sample collection.
What is the cost of the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test?
The cost of the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test varies by location and ongoing offers. Visit our website or contact us for the latest pricing and discounts.
How soon will I receive the results for the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test?
Results for the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test are typically delivered within 24-48 hours. You can access them online or receive them via email.
Can the Thyrocare Anemia Profile Advanced test identify other health issues?
Yes, this test provides insights into various health conditions, such as nutritional deficiencies, chronic diseases, and overall wellness, apart from detecting anemia.
Why choose Thyrocare for the Anemia Profile Advanced test?
Thyrocare offers affordable pricing, NABL-certified labs, accurate testing, and convenient home sample collection, ensuring a smooth and reliable diagnostic experience.
